newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline barges fall $8.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline barges fall $8.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed as gasoline tumbled before the U.K. budget next week.
Fuel oil prices firmed as U.S. arbitrage buyers moved into Europe, especially concentrating on high sulphur grades. Heavy Italian buying supported low sulphur.
Gas oil fell by $4.75 on IPE futures. Barge premiums eased slightly but those for cargoes were unchanged.
Naphtha slipped but a sharp U.S. propane rally should keep the arbitrage attractive to drain supplies from NWE.
Gasoline barges tumbled to meet Dec swaps values and as fears mounted of extra supply after the U.K. budget.
